topic: How does frequency planning address atmospheric absorption and interference in mmWave/THz bands for hybrid satellite-terrestrial networks?
consensus_response: Frequency planning must consider the physical mechanism behind atmospheric absorption and interference, including gas and cloud effects. The array factor of satellite antennas plays a crucial role in mitigating terrestrial network interference. Mitigation techniques like link power control, site diversity, and adaptive coding and modulation are essential to address these effects. Frequency reuse configurations can be implemented to improve spectral efficiency, but this increases the complexity of the system.
